title: [Bug]: autogen.agentchat.register_function adds to all Agents instead of single
body:
### Describe the bug

autogen.agentchat.register_function( X

There is an critical issue as above functions seems to add tools to all Agents, where I would expect it to add only to specified agent. See in logs: "WRONG WRITER tools:..."

### Steps to reproduce

```python
from autogen import AssistantAgent, UserProxyAgent, ConversableAgent, config_list_from_json
import autogen
from pprint import pprint

config_list = config_list_from_json(env_or_file="OAI_CONFIG_LIST")
gpt4_config = {
    "cache_seed": 42,  # change the cache_seed for different trials
    "temperature": 0,
    "config_list": config_list,
    "timeout": 120,
}

picker = autogen.AssistantAgent(
    name="PICKER",
    system_message="""PICKER. Suggest the most fitting workflow to fullfil the user task.""",
    llm_config=gpt4_config,
)

writer = autogen.AssistantAgent(
    name="WRITER",
    system_message="""You are a an text writer
""",
    llm_config=gpt4_config,
)

def hello_world():
    return "Hello, World!"

autogen.agentchat.register_function(
    hello_world,
    caller=picker,
    executor=picker,
    name="hello_world",
    description="run a shell script and return the execution result.",
)

print("PICKER tools:")
pprint(picker.llm_config["tools"]) # Correct

print("")
print("WRONG WRITER tools:") 
pprint(writer.llm_config["tools"]) # Wrongly Added the hello_world function to the writer tools

```

### Model Used

_No response_

### Expected Behavior

Add only to picker agent

### Screenshots and logs

The return type of the function 'hello_world' is not annotated. Although annotating it is optional, the function should return either a string, a subclass of 'pydantic.BaseModel'.
PICKER tools:
[{'function': {'description': 'run a shell script and return the execution '
                              'result.',
               'name': 'hello_world',
               'parameters': {'properties': {},
                              'required': [],
                              'type': 'object'}},
  'type': 'function'}]

WRONG WRITER tools:
[{'function': {'description': 'run a shell script and return the execution '
                              'result.',
               'name': 'hello_world',
               'parameters': {'properties': {},
                              'required': [],
                              'type': 'object'}},
  'type': 'function'}]
